title: Chapter whereby one is not burnt with fire

verses.t: Chapter whereby one is not burnt with fire, but drinketh water in the Netherworld.
O Bull of Amenta! let me be borne to thee!
I am that Rudder of Râ, wherewith he conveyeth the Ancient ones.
I am not burnt, I am not consumed.
I am Babai, the eldest son of Osiris, who striketh the eye of every god in Heliopolis.
I am the Heir, the primary power of motion and of rest.
I have made firm my name, and have preserved it that I may have life through it.
Chapter whereby one is not boiled in water.
I am that ready Rudder wherewith Râ conveyeth the Ancient ones, and I raise the effluxes of Osiris to the Tank from flames impassable; a wrecked one, but not to be consumed.
I lie helpless as a dead person, and I arrive at the lair of the Lion who defieth slaughter,... following the road by which I set out.
